messages:
noa_cs: Kicking off Kaldera Labs onboarding thread. Goal: pilot -> gated prod in ~3 weeks. Need owners for SSO, data export, perf, and an exec-ready cost summary. Quick sync to lock people and risks. :wave:

diego_impl: I can own integration (SSO + export). Quick Q: pilot wants daily CSV or event webhook? Also, do they need signed SAML assertions?

faye_eng: From infra: SAML only for pilot is fine. Flag: Kaldera runs long-context document assembly (~7k tokens) in some flows. Recommend an A/B eval (full precision vs 4-bit quant) to compare cost/quality.

lucy_pm: Product success criteria: 1) SSO with test users + IdP metadata validated, 2) daily export to their BigQuery schema validated, 3) median chat latency <250ms and embeddings p95 <2s during 48h pilot window, 4) cost-per-10k-tokens at or below target after baseline. Exec demo must show cost delta vs incumbent provider.

harry_renewals: Renewal context: renewal is Q4; primary risk is unpredictable token spend. I'll draft a one-pager for finance that shows baseline comparison and projected savings if quantized models pass QA.

noa_cs: Proposed owners: Noa = CS lead, Diego = Integration lead, Faye = Eng perf lead, Lucy = PM liaison, Harry = Renewal liaison. Agree?

diego_impl: Agree. I'll create a Confluence "integration checklist": IdP metadata fields, sample CSV schema (include route_id and token_count), retention & encryption (TLS + AES-256). Will ask Kaldera for sample rows and IdP metadata today.

faye_eng: I'll spin up a staging route and run two 24h passes: (1) interactive daytime profile, (2) overnight batch embeddings. Need sample traffic shape from Lucy. I'll include A/B test harness for model-variant eval.

lucy_pm: Sending traffic profile and prompt anonymization guidance in a DM. Kaldera asked for a sanitize script; we'll provide one.

invite-bot: Meeting created: "Kaldera Internal Onboard Prep" Tue 10am PT  invite sent to participants.

noa_cs: Action items for today: 1) Diego: Confluence integration checklist + data contract (EOD). 2) Faye: staging perf plan + A/B test template. 3) Lucy: traffic profile + anonymization plan. 4) Harry: draft renewal one-pager. 5) Noa: request IdP metadata and baseline spend from customer.

diego_impl: Noted. I'll also include a note about potential SCIM Phase 2 and webhook as later enhancements.

faye_eng: Flagging Optimize/Runtime for follow-up if quantization affects quality.

noa_cs: Thanks team 389 I'll consolidate and run the internal sync before the customer kickoff. :rocket:
